title: cdk-context examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples for @sevenpico/cdk-context in packages/cdk-context/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — required props only (namespace, environment, stage)
- comprehensive/ — all props exercised (all labelOrder, labelKeyCase, labelValueCase options, custom delimiter, attributes, tags, idLengthLimit)
- disabled/ — enabled:false to demonstrate the zero-resources pattern

Each scenario is a CDK app in all 5 languages (TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go). Each scenario directory contains: app.ts (and language equivalents), cdk.json referencing the shared bridge fixture, README.md.

Add CDK assertion tests to packages/cdk-context/test/context-examples.test.ts validating the Tag output and resource naming for each scenario.

comments.author: resource-specialist
comments.body: Starting cdk-context examples for all 5 languages across 3 scenarios
